generic_lessons: To distinguish persistence from deterministic reconstruction, save the record in a later world turn and verify that its original creation turn survives reload.
A conservative migration can succeed while blocking forward progress. Record both results and the practical gameplay limitation.
Match the actual engine Lua parser when checking generated action wrappers; syntax accepted by a newer isolated runtime may be rejected before any game action.
Inspect the real source consumer before selecting a similarly named UI API; a context label is not a namespace.
Ordinary turn ACK and next-turn readiness remain separate during diplomacy. Stop dependent work, handle the actual player interaction, then requalify readiness.
